newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank of Lebanon gross reserves rise in end-Dec.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Lebanon gross reserves rise in end-Dec.

text.p: The Bank of Lebanon's gross foreign exchange reserves rose $105.77 million in the second half of December to $5,885.65 million from $5,779.88 million, according to central bank figures published on Friday.
Gross reserves rose by $12.43 million in the first half of December. Gross reserves include commercial bank's foreign exchange deposits with the central bank.
The balance sheet did not give the bank's net reserves but banking sources said they stood at about $4,015 million at end December.
Net reserves were $2,858 million at the end of 1995 compared with $2,732 million at the end of 1994.
